title: fix: log upstream terminal response errors
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `finish_reason: "error"` responses to the private 24-hour `error_event` datasource.
- Records credential-redacted request inputs and parsed JSON/SSE output.
- Preserves the client response and existing unbilled 502 health classification.
- Extends tracking coverage for the detailed error event.

gist.headline: The error jar got labels
gist.blurb: When an upstream request ends with an error, the hive now keeps a careful, redacted record of what happened. Same client response, much better trail of breadcrumbs.
gist.summary: Added 24-hour private error-event tracking for upstream responses with `finish_reason: "error"`, including credential-redacted request inputs and parsed JSON or SSE output while preserving existing client responses and unbilled 502 classification.
gist.impact: Maintainers can diagnose terminal upstream failures with the original request context and parsed response data, without exposing credentials or changing what clients receive.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful incident librarian in a cozy server-garden, placing a redacted error scroll and a glowing JSON/SSE printout into a clearly labeled 24-hour archive jar. A friendly CRT monitor robot helps inspect the trail while code-plants and small flowers make the internal debugging work feel warm rather than alarming.
